form.name_info: The item name as it appears in lists, invoices, and plan breakdowns.
form.description_info: Optional detail shown on detail pages and product-facing documents.
form.line_info: Product line this item belongs to. Used for grouping and filtering.
form.price_info: Default unit price in the selected currency. Stored in centavos; displayed divided by 100.
form.currency_info: Currency applied to this item's default price.
form.active_info: Inactive items are hidden from selection in new plans and transactions.
form.variant_mode_info: Turn on if this product has options (e.g. size, color) that produce distinct SKUs. Price is then set per-variant rather than on this form.
form.unit_info: Free-text display unit (e.g. ea, lb, kg, hr, session). Tenants choose their own convention.
form.variant_mode_locked_help: Delete all variants and options first to change this setting.
form.variant_mode_locked_error: Delete all variants and options before changing the variant mode.
form.product_kind_info: What kind of thing this is — determines inventory behaviour, GL posting, and which sidebar surfaces carry it.

product_kind_value_info.service: Not a physical good. No inventory, no stock tracking. Examples: consultation, haircut, license.
product_kind_value_info.stocked_good: Physical good you carry in inventory and resell. Stock is counted. Examples: retail item, finished product.
product_kind_value_info.non_stocked_good: Physical good you sell but do not stock. Drop-shipped or special-ordered. Examples: custom furniture, one-off import.
product_kind_value_info.consumable: Back-of-house supply used to deliver a service — expensed on use. Examples: gauze, lotion, cleaning solution, coffee beans.

form.delivery_mode_info: Drives the fulfillment UI, revenue recognition timing, and invoice template.

delivery_mode_value_info.instant: Handed over at point of sale — retail checkout or walk-in.
delivery_mode_value_info.project: Multi-milestone fulfillment — a case or engagement.
delivery_mode_value_info.subscription: Recurring access over time — monthly SaaS, gym membership.

form.tracking_mode_info: How per-unit inventory is counted. Only meaningful for physical goods.

tracking_mode_value_info.none: No inventory tracking. Default for services and non-stocked goods.
tracking_mode_value_info.serialized: Per-unit — one row per physical unit. Use for high-value electronics, regulated stock.

form.tax_treatment_info: How this product is classified for tax purposes: Standard (taxed), Reduced (lower rate), Zero Rated (0% tax, audit trail preserved), Exempt (no tax row), or Out of Scope (no tax row).
form.withholding_class_info: The withholding tax class that applies when the buyer is a top withholding agent (TWA). Leave blank for products not subject to creditable withholding tax.

validation.price_required_for_simple: Price is required when this product is not variant-configurable.
